spec.headline: Growth Marketing | Incrementality & LTV | Conversion Testing
spec.headline_rationale: Maximus emphasizes incrementality, customer value, experimentation and connected conversion journeys. The master directly supports incremental CPA and brand holdouts, LTV and promotion analysis, funnel tests, bid experiments, budget models and consumer growth leadership. Avoid unsupported telehealth, subscription, quiz-flow or pricing-portfolio ownership claims.
spec.summary: Performance marketing leader focused on the economics of growth: incrementality, customer value and conversion. Analyzed lifetime value, incremental CPA, brand holdouts, affiliate economics and promotions, and used regression models to guide budget decisions. Led an eight-person e-commerce team, improved ROAS from 1.5 to 3.5 while scaling monthly volume fourfold, and coordinated campaign, content and website priorities. Combines hands-on experimentation, revenue-oriented reporting and agency evaluation across paid acquisition and commerce programs.
spec.factual_review: Read exact Maximus posting and current v4 Word master. E002/E004/E006/E010/E011 support incrementality, LTV, affiliate/discount analysis, experiment design, investment models and agency economics. E037/E093/E095/E096/E099 support growth results, team leadership, conversion testing and revenue/KPI reporting. E044/E076/E114 support connected content and website collaboration. Do not add subscription-growth, clinical/telehealth, regulated-ad-policy, end-to-end quiz/checkout ownership or formal pricing-portfolio claims.
spec.tools_rationale: These master-supported platforms emphasize hands-on acquisition, analytical testing, reporting, AI-assisted analysis and CRM work relevant to Maximus. Do not substitute unsupported clinical or subscription-specific technology.
